You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From bffc2f7aa96343f91931272d7a8a2d8d925e1ab2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Vasily Gorbik <gor@linux.ibm.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2020 18:27:36 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] s390/vmem: fix vmem_add_range for 4-level paging

The kernel currently crashes if 4-level paging is used. Add missing
p4d_populate for just allocated pud entry.

Fixes: 3e0d3e408e63 ("s390/vmem: consolidate vmem_add_range() and vmem_remove_range()")
Reviewed-by: Gerald Schaefer <gerald.schaefer@linux.ibm.com>
Signed-off-by: Vasily Gorbik <gor@linux.ibm.com>
---
 arch/s390/mm/vmem.c | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/arch/s390/mm/vmem.c b/arch/s390/mm/vmem.c
index 1aed1a4dfc2d..eddf71c22875 100644
--- a/arch/s390/mm/vmem.c
+++ b/arch/s390/mm/vmem.c
@@ -402,6 +402,7 @@ static int modify_p4d_table(pgd_t *pgd, unsigned long addr, unsigned long end,
 			pud = vmem_crst_alloc(_REGION3_ENTRY_EMPTY);
 			if (!pud)
 				goto out;
+			p4d_populate(&init_mm, p4d, pud);
 		}
 		ret = modify_pud_table(p4d, addr, next, add, direct);
 		if (ret)
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The kernel crash when using 4-level paging was due to the missing call to `p4d_populate` for the newly allocated Page Upper Directory (PUD) entry. This omission prevented the proper linking of the P4D entry to the PUD, leading to an invalid memory access when the kernel attempted to use the PUD entry, resulting in a crash.
